items.title: 14 Killed in Weapons Depot Blast in Northwest Syria
items.summary: Officials said they had not determined the cause of the explosion. Years of fighting have left Syria littered with weapons and ordnance left over from the civil war.

items.title: How a Driver’s Sudden Death Triggered Ebola Panic in Congo
items.summary: When a truck driver unexpectedly collapsed and died in a remote village, frontline medical staff scrambled to safely isolate his body, triggering a standoff.

items.title: Europe Unites to Pressure Israel, Breaking With U.S.
items.summary: Britain once followed in France’s slipstream when it came to pressuring Israel. Under new leadership, it is spearheading opposition to Israeli settlements, risking American anger.

items.title: U.S. Takes Aim at New Target in Deadly Boat Strike Campaign

items.title: Police Expand Investigation Into Reform U.K. After Undercover Sting

items.title: Ukraine’s Unexpected $27 Billion Budget Gap Rattles Europe

items.title: Singapore’s Prime Minister Gets a Big Raise
items.summary: Singapore’s prime minister, Lawrence Wong, got the bump as part of a longstanding policy to pay high salaries to public servants in order to attract top talent and prevent corruption.

items.title: Thousands Gather for Funeral of Norway’s King Harald

items.title: This Tiny Anti-Establishment Party May Put Germany’s Far Right in Power

items.title: Trump’s Midterm Pitch Clouded by Iran War and Canada Tariffs

items.title: Joseph Rice, Lowcountry Lawyer Who Took On Big Tobacco, Dies at 72

items.title: Bond Market Rebuffs Treasury’s $6 Billion Plan to Reduce Borrowing Costs

items.title: Saudi Oil Exports Plunge as Spread of War Shuts Off Shipping Routes

items.title: Measuring the Cost of Trump’s Multiple Wars
